_meta.purpose: Machine-readable companion to melodic_techno_spec.md section B. Numbers marked "measured" are pulled directly from Source/Engine/BassRhythmGrammar.h (generated from MLPipeline/drum_grammar/output/bass_grammar.json).
_meta.generated_from: Source/Engine/BassRhythmGrammar.h as of the bass-groove milestone

groove_subset.note_on_onKickFraction: measurably BELOW the uniform baseline - real syncopation around the kick, not an absolute exclusion

rolling_continuous.note: the bass equivalent of the HAT corpus's excluded rollers - a different production tool, not a groove target

sustained_padstyle.criterion: mean note length > 2.5 steps, or < 4 notes/bar
sustained_padstyle.note: harmonic-pad role, not a rhythmic groove - candidate BREAKDOWN_BASS material for a future phase, not DROP_BASS

external_corroboration.movement: root + fifth (harmonic width), walkdowns via minor third or flat seventh
external_corroboration.register: keep range to one octave, mostly root and fifth
external_corroboration.kick_relationship: notes land on 'the and of every beat' - offbeat placement forced by kick decay length (300-500ms, no room on the downbeat)
external_corroboration.agreement_with_measured: close - measured 74.7% root vs guide's ~70%; measured intervals include the fifth (+/-7) and third-family (-4/+3) the guide names

sidechain.sequencing_level_gap: implemented - kBassKickCorrelation derived from measured onKickFraction

mix_level_dsp_gap.status: NOT implemented - no sidechain/ducking DSP exists anywhere in the plugin
mix_level_dsp_gap.note: distinct from sequencing-level kick avoidance - both are real techniques, only the sequencing one is implemented

voice_architecture_note: Bass notes are inherently ~1 step long in the current melody-voice trigger model (PluginProcessor.cpp retriggers noteOn/noteOff every step boundary regardless of whether the pitch changed) - this already matches the measured 1.32-step mean reasonably well without needing an explicit note-length parameter.
